input.goal: Dredge each Chicken-cheese ball into flour, then dip into egg and roll in the breadcrumbs, ensuring the entire surface of the chicken ball is covered in breadcrumbs.

sub_goals.text: Set up the breadcrumbs in a bowl
Store the breadcrumbs container and prepare the flour bowl
Retrieve flour from the cabinet and pour it into the bowl
Form the first chicken ball and coat it with flour
Dip the first chicken ball in egg and coat it with breadcrumbs
Form the second chicken ball and coat it with flour
Dip the second chicken ball in egg, sprinkle with more flour, and coat it with breadcrumbs

plan.goal: Dredge each Chicken-cheese ball into flour, then dip into egg and roll in the breadcrumbs, ensuring the entire surface of the chicken ball is covered in breadcrumbs.

events.description: Pour breadcrumbs from a container into a bowl.
events.relevance: prepares the breadcrumbs station for dredging

events.description: Dry breadcrumbs rustle as they hit the bowl.
Move the breadcrumbs container away from the workspace.
events.relevance: clears space for the next dredging station

events.description: Place an empty bowl on the counter.
events.relevance: sets up the receptacle for the flour

events.description: Pour flour from a package into the empty bowl.
events.relevance: completes the setup of the flour dredging station

events.description: Shape the chicken mixture into a round ball using hands.
events.relevance: creates the first chicken ball to be coated

events.description: Place the chicken ball into the flour bowl and roll it around.
events.relevance: applies the first layer of the dredging process

events.description: Transfer the floured chicken ball into a bowl of egg and turn it.
events.relevance: applies the binder layer for the breadcrumbs

events.description: Move the egg-coated ball into the breadcrumbs bowl and roll it until covered.
events.relevance: completes the dredging process for the first ball

events.description: Shape a second portion of chicken mixture into a ball.
Place the second chicken ball into the flour bowl and roll it.
events.relevance: applies the first layer of dredging to the second ball

events.description: Transfer the second floured chicken ball into the egg bowl.
events.relevance: applies the egg binder to the second ball

events.description: Sprinkle additional flour over the chicken ball.
events.relevance: ensures the ball is fully dry/coated before the final breadcrumb layer

events.description: Move the ball into the breadcrumbs bowl and roll it until fully covered.
events.relevance: completes the dredging process for the second ball

relations.ask: What container is being moved away?
relations.answer_hint: The container that was just used to pour the breadcrumbs.

relations.ask: What powder is the chicken ball being rolled in?
relations.answer_hint: The flour that was just poured into the bowl.

relations.ask: What state is the chicken ball in before being transferred to the egg?
relations.answer_hint: It has just been coated in flour.

relations.ask: Which chicken ball is being transferred into the egg bowl?
relations.answer_hint: The second chicken ball that was just formed and floured.

decision_points.why: The person must decide to stop pouring breadcrumbs, clean up the container, and prepare the next bowl for flour.
The person must decide to retrieve the flour to fill the newly placed empty bowl.
The dredging stations are set up, so the person must decide to transition from preparation to actually forming the first chicken ball.
The person must decide that the ball has enough flour and it is time to move it to the egg and breadcrumb stages.
The first ball is finished, so the person must decide to start the process over for the second ball.
The person must decide the second ball is sufficiently floured and move it to the egg and breadcrumb bowls.
Both chicken balls are fully coated, so the person must decide that the dredging task is complete.
